title: Juicy Crunchy Brazilian Brie Skewers
description: A sour and crunchy Brazilian dish featuring marinated brie cheese, perfect for a snack or light meal. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with sensitivities.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the softened brie cheese to the marinade and mix until well coated.
Thread the marinated brie cheese, pita bread cubes, pineapple chunks, and macadamia nuts onto skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is toasted.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro and mint.
Serve the skewers warm and enjoy.
